record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、LLM inference efficiencyとの接続、効果の一般性または技術的な新規性が弱く、理由を付してborderlineに残す。The study characterizes LLaMA 1B/3B/7B serving on RTX6000 Ada and T4 and models operational plus embodied carbon. It informs serving hardware/configuration tradeoffs but proposes no runtime optimization algorithm.
record.title: Towards Sustainable Large Language Model Serving
